# Eventora AI

> Eventora AI is an intelligent, GenAI-powered event planning and production assistant designed to orchestrate celebrations, weddings, corporate summits, galas, and milestone gatherings.

## Website & Public Links
- Canonical Website: https://event-planner-liard-beta.vercel.app
- Authentication & Sign-in: https://event-planner-liard-beta.vercel.app/auth
- Sitemap: https://event-planner-liard-beta.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
- Robots Policy: https://event-planner-liard-beta.vercel.app/robots.txt

## Key Capabilities & Features

### 1. GenAI Event Plan Generation
- Generates end-to-end, structured event blueprints tailored to event type, guest count, location, cultural context, and budget.
- Produces itemized budget allocations, milestone timelines, vendor staffing specs, and curated theme concepts.
- Supported event types include Indian and multicultural weddings, corporate summits, birthday galas, anniversaries, and custom celebrations.

### 2. Smart Budget Orchestration
- Dynamically allocates event budgets across key categories (Venue, Catering, Decor, Photography, Entertainment, Logistics).
- Real-time expense tracking, spent-vs-allocated analytics, and remaining budget calculation in INR (₹).

### 3. Phased Milestone Timeline
- Organizes event milestones across chronological phases (6 months before, 3 months, 1 month, 2 weeks, 1 week, and event day).
- Tracks task priorities (high, medium, low), category tags, due dates, and real-time completion status.

### 4. Vendor Lifecycle Management
- Tracks event vendor categories including Venue, Catering, Decor, Photography, DJ & Music, Floral, and Transportation.
- Manages vendor contact records, contract statuses (Inquiry, Shortlisted, Booked, Completed), and payment balances.

### 5. Guest & RSVP Tracking
- Tracks guest rosters, party sizes, attendance statuses (Confirmed, Attending, Pending, Declined), and dietary restrictions.
- Computes confirmed headcount and dietary breakdowns in real time.

### 6. Interactive 24/7 AI Event Assistant
- Context-aware conversational AI assistant capable of answering questions, recommending catering adjustments, troubleshooting timelines, and suggesting creative event concepts based on active event plans.

### 7. AI Invitation Drafting
- Crafts culturally nuanced invitation copy, formal card text, and concise WhatsApp/SMS broadcast drafts tailored to tone (formal, warm, poetic, modern).
